description: This file defines the Logger class used for logging debug information within the calculation engine of PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages debug messages, echoing, and maintains a stack of cell references during calculations.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A logger class for recording debug information during spreadsheet calculations. It controls whether debug logs are recorded or echoed, and maintains a stack to track cell references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Logger with a cell reference stack.

methods.name: setWriteDebugLog
methods.description: Enables or disables writing debug logs.

methods.name: getWriteDebugLog
methods.description: Returns whether writing debug logs is enabled.

methods.name: setEchoDebugLog
methods.description: Enables or disables echoing debug logs.

methods.name: getEchoDebugLog
methods.description: Returns whether echoing debug logs is enabled.

methods.name: writeDebugLog
methods.description: Writes an entry to the debug log, optionally echoing it.

methods.name: mergeDebugLog
methods.description: Appends multiple entries to the debug log.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Returns the current debug log entries.
